notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, adding {R}.
Repeat until each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
